operation_basis.mileage_scope: Booked and operated train-km cover passenger, positioning and yard movements. Operated train-km uses actual replay distance, including any partial workings.

cash.scope: Existing opening cash schedule and 30 operating years, including attributable renewals.

excluded_scope: Ordinary drainage, elevated works, standard support works, bearing upkeep and renewals remain in existing civil lots.
Water occurrence shows historical surface water in sampled pixels. Groundwater, flood depth, drainage design and scour remain outside these additions.
Clay percentage is a shallow regional proxy. Stratigraphy, compressibility, seismic response, pile design and foundation acceptance require their own evidence.
The closure allowance leaves permanent geometry, its construction sequence, exceptional crossings and route utilities open.
Site-specific upkeep, renewals, delivery delay and owner risk remain outside the site increments.

footing_sensitivity.scope: Independent shallow bearing sensitivities at the governing bent load and DEM-profile height. Failed fixed pads are resized at the supports without a shaft allowance. Trial bearing pressures are separate inputs and do not come from mapped clay or water.

gis-end-closure-allowance.basis: One comparable standard bay as a cost allowance for the exceptional end closure. Uses the same stock, installed rates and cost bands, with existing form and common elevated costs excluded.

gis-foundation-allowance.basis: Trial shafts below the stock pad retained as a cap. Uses the Airport ground scenarios and GIS exposure to allocate candidate positions in place of enlarged pads.

gis-pier-height.basis: Extra column concrete and bar above the standard 6 m stock datum, with the existing support works allowance prorated by concrete volume. Retain the standard price where columns are shorter.

gis-shallow-footing.basis: Enlarged pad volume above the standard footing, including steel and existing excavation and installation rates prorated by concrete volume. Uses independent 250/200/150 kPa shallow trial assumptions for low/base/high cost. Pile-allowance positions retain the stock pad as a trial cap.

soil.method: Native-grid WCS crop and nearest cell. Divide stored g/kg by ten. The WCS crops omit the native no-data marker. The native deep mean tile confirms the sampled values and identifies missing cells. All four crops return zero on those missing cells. Clay prediction is a texture proxy.

rasters.purpose: Validate deep mean samples and recover the native soil coverage mask

terrain.method: Nearest surface cell. Buildings, infrastructure and vegetation can influence elevations.
terrain.product: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 public digital surface model
terrain.version: COG tile N33E044, AWS object last modified 2022-05-09

water.attribution: Source: EC JRC/Google. Pekel et al. (2016), doi:10.1038/nature20584.
water.horizontal_resolution: nominal 30 m (0.00025° in the delivered tile)
water.method: Nearest cell and maximum valid observation occurrence among pixel centres within 100 m. 255 is no data. Roads and bridges can obscure underlying water in this surface layer.
water.units: historical water occurrence percentage normalised by calendar month
